name: SupervisorDashboardPage

description: Comprehensive dashboard showing ticket statistics, team performance metrics, SLA compliance, queue status, agent workload distribution, and trending reports with administrative functions

config.text: Monitor team performance, ticket metrics, and SLA compliance

name: ReportsPage
title: Reports & Analytics
description: Reporting page showing ticket metrics, SLA compliance reports, agent performance, category distribution, resolution time trends, and custom report generation

name: TicketListPage
title: All Tickets
description: List page showing tickets with filtering, sorting, and search capabilities. Displays ticket number, title, status, priority, category, assigned agent, and dates. Supports bulk operations and export.

name: NewTicketPage
title: Submit New Support Ticket
description: Form page for end users to submit new support tickets with guided input, category selection, priority selection, rich text description, and file attachments

config.text: Please provide detailed information about your issue. Our support team will respond as soon as possible.

• Provide a clear and descriptive title
• Select the appropriate category for faster routing
• Include all relevant details in the description
• Attach screenshots or files if applicable
• Priority will be reviewed by our support team

name: QueueManagementPage
title: Queue Management
description: Administrative page for supervisors to create, configure, and manage queues, assign agents to queues, and view queue statistics.

config.text: Create and manage support queues, assign agents, and monitor queue performance

name: CategoryManagementPage
title: Category Management
description: Administrative page for supervisors to create, update, and configure ticket categories and their routing rules

config.text: Create and configure ticket categories with routing rules to appropriate queues

name: PriorityManagementPage
title: Priority Management
description: Administrative page for supervisors to configure priority levels, SLA timeframes, and escalation rules

config.text: Configure priority levels, SLA timeframes, and escalation rules for ticket management

name: StatusManagementPage
title: Status Management
description: Administrative page for supervisors to configure status types, allowed transitions, and status properties

config.text: Configure status types, workflow transitions, and status properties for ticket management

name: UserManagementPage
title: User Management
description: Administrative page for supervisors to view, create, update, and manage user accounts, role assignments, and access permissions.

title: My Dashboard

name: AgentDashboardPage
title: Agent Dashboard
description: Dashboard page showing agent's assigned tickets, queue statistics, SLA alerts, recent activity, and workload metrics. Provides quick access to ticket management functions.

description: Detail page showing all ticket information including description, status, priority, category, assignment, comments, attachments, history, and SLA status. Provides access to ticket actions based on user role.
